integrity: Analytic global prime bounds plus exhaustive finite divisor-triple comparison with standalone standard-library verifier. No inference of unbounded validity from finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: Only exactly three omitted divisors, exactly three distinct prime factors, and four prime factors with multiplicity; does not classify all three-near-perfect integers. Published equivalences may exist outside inspected sources.
title: Classification of three-near-perfect integers with exactly four prime factors
